en.title: Inspect Web migration and original Android packaging from one project
en.body: Compare target-specific next actions, script order and limits, source locations for host calls and an observed native startup failure.

zh.title: 从同一份旧工程盘点 Web 迁移和原版 Android 打包
zh.body: 分别查看下一步动作、脚本顺序与上限，定位宿主调用，并将真机启动故障对应到原发布脚本。
